answer: Forging a fresh identity requires re-earning that record from the kernel outward, so each fake costs a full bond plus repeated peer review, making mass sockpuppetry strictly more expensive than honest participation. Sybil resistance here binds identity to costly work: each agent must stake a bond and pass a prism test that splits claimed history into verifiable epochs, checked against the public trellis of prior attestations. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
